svg.text: BUZZER SIMULATOR | M2-G1 CITY DESIGN ACCEPTANCE
Coordinate freeze, visual decisions D1-D8, 3D blockout readiness — director review package.
Planning evidence only: a drawing, never a Roblox Studio capture. Baseline master 09eb88d626d73057543fe419a2c0925063d1df09.
Values traced to parent tables and to verified Bedroom.rbxmx anchors. North = -Z, east = +X. No approval inferred from any view.
DIRECTOR APPROVED — none yet in this package
1 | FULL CITY TOP-DOWN — frozen baseline with overlays
Scale 4 px/stud. Zones and anchors are the parent contract; dashed red items are proposals that are NOT adopted here.
Grade Y = 0; no elevation change in A/B
City grows south from the Door plane
2 | D1 SKYLINE / BACKDROP ALIGNMENT — baseline X=16..160 versus proposed X=-120..120
Same Z extent -192..-112 in both candidates. Rays are the true desk-camera projection of the frozen window aperture.
Green band = the only sky visible
from the desk; all else occluded
Baseline X=16..160 covers 0% of the slice
Slice width 59.6 studs at that depth
clear of the backdrop: no intersection
city envelope, so no background breach
Adopt the proposed centred extent X=-120..120 as the candidate for isolated Studio verification;
keep X=16..160 as the frozen baseline until a real camera view confirms the candidate.
Director guidance is explicit: do not freeze new coordinates on a 2D projection alone.
3 | D2 KIOSK — standard solid versus narrow open-frame, both inside frozen Z6
Zone Z6 stays x -12..+12, z +64..+72. The prompt anchor (0, 3, 68) is not moved by either candidate.
Solid 10-stud panel blocks the plaza sightline from the stoop
Width 6 studs (B) vs 10 (A) | height 6.0 | posts 5 studs apart
Route clearance 6 studs each side | BaseParts ~10 | prompt at (0, 3, 68)
Fountain visible from the stoop: A NO / B YES
Sign readable on a 360x640 phone: A YES / B YES
Mobile camera obstruction: A HIGH / B LOW
Two 1-stud posts and a 5-stud band; fountain stays visible
Width 6 studs (B) vs 10 (A) | height 6.0 | posts 5 studs apart
Route clearance 6 studs each side | BaseParts ~10 | prompt at (0, 3, 68)
Fountain visible from the stoop: A NO / B YES
Sign readable on a 360x640 phone: A YES / B YES
Mobile camera obstruction: A HIGH / B LOW
Blue = frozen Z6 extent. Amber = 8-stud plaza edge band. Green rays = stoop -> kiosk -> fountain sightlines.
D2 RECOMMENDATION: build candidate B (narrow open-frame) first. It keeps fountain visibility, walking clearance and mobile
readability simultaneously; the solid panel only wins on sign area, which candidate B can recover with a taller band.
4 | D3 HOUSE EXTERIOR — front facade and side elevation
Shell wraps the frozen 24x24 room at a 0.6-stud offset (x/z -12.6..+12.6). Grade begins at z=+16. No roof plane in A1.
Doorway cut x -7.85..-4.15, y 0..7.3, aligned to the
Window aperture (blue) is frozen glass; cladding
must never cover it (V-03 / window projection)
Parapet at y = 11.9, no roof plane, no interior
ceiling; roof waits for a camera-collision test
4-stud stoop between Door plane z=11.69 and grade
z=+16; City_HomeDoor on the exterior face
City_Spawn (-6, 0.6, 20) is 4 studs clear of the shell
Wall returns bridge HomeDoor to the shell
No physical passage through the frozen Door
5 | MAIN ROUTE CLEARANCES — stoop to kiosk to fountain to gate
Scale 2 px/stud. Blue guides mark the 6-stud corridor; the green ring is the 8-stud fountain clearance.
Walkable clear width >= 6 studs on every path
Lane x -24..+24 is the walkable corridor
Kiosk inside Z6 leaves both lanes open
Estimates only; A1 must measure on foot
Red dots: City_Spawn and City_Prompt_Boards. Amber: the single spine route. Estimates, not measured walk times.
6 | D4 SHOP PROMPT APPROACH — baseline hosts, 10-stud activation, 12-stud validation
Scale 2.5 px/stud. Hosts stay at baseline +/-68; relocation would be a documented amendment, never a silent edit.
Counter face 4 studs inside the lot edge
Standing position ~6 studs from the host
Open-front counter: no closed interior, so no
camera clipping and no interior lighting cost
No prop may sit between lane and prompt host
D4 CONCLUSION: baseline hosts are reachable inside the existing 10/12 constraints with an open-front counter. No coordinate amendment is
requested. All distances are pre-production estimates until measured in the A1 blockout.
7 | D6 CAMERA EXPERIENCE — nine compositions for M2-A1 Studio capture
Existing camera controller only; no new controller is introduced by M2-G1. None of these is verified without a Studio capture.
room centre looking +Z at the Door
Acceptance criteria per view are defined in M2-A1-READINESS.md; screenshot positions must be recorded with pose, aspect and mode.
8 | D7 BASEPART ALLOCATION — allocation ledger, not a measured Studio count
Counting contract: every BasePart once in assembled Workspace.City, invisible markers included inside the allocation.
Count each BasePart once in the assembled
the physical HomeDoor, pivot parts and every
placed copy of a shared-kit prop
Temporary review helpers removed before evidence
Bedroom stays on its own <= 350 budget
Bars are relative allocation, not measurements
Bedroom (155 parts) is excluded here — it lives on its own budget. No exact Studio count exists until a generator produces one.
M2-G1 planning evidence | no approval, FPS, streaming or runtime behaviour is inferred from this drawing.
